metadata.name: workspace-edit-basic
metadata.description: Smoke proof for the unified Workspace (Stage 0b): navigates to /workspace and asserts the surface composes end-to-end — the mode switcher renders, the canvas exposes its upload dropzone, and the Edit-mode operation picker is populated via OpsService.ListOperations (UI -> Connect-RPC -> internal/ops registry). A broken discovery RPC, an unmounted ops module, or a Workspace that fails to compose all fail here. Op execution + crop drag-box are covered by the Stage-1 Edit-hero journey; the multipart run edge is covered by api/handlers/ops/rest_test.go and the headless CLI acceptance in docs/internal/TESTING.md.

assert.failure_message: Operation picker does not list 'Resize' — OpsService.ListOperations did not reach the Workspace (check the ops module is mounted in main.go, the OpsService handler is registered, and ui/src/api/ops.ts targets the right transport).

metadata.label: Assert the deterministic op catalog renders in the Inspector (proves discovery end-to-end)
